name: claude-peers-mcp — Ad-Hoc Peer Messaging Between Claude Instances
hook: 2.1k stars. Allows every Claude Code session running on your machine to discover the others and send messages ad-hoc — no cloud, no orchestration framework. A local broker daemon (SQLite + HTTP on localhost:7899) handles peer registration; each session's MCP server polls for inbound messages and pushes them into the Claude channel so they appear instantly. Practical use: spin up a planning agent and a coding agent in separate terminals, let them coordinate directly without any hand-rolled API. Already cross-listed on LobeHub, SkillsMP, and mcpmarket — viral pick-up for a small repo.
install: git clone https://github.com/louislva/claude-peers-mcp ~/claude-peers-mcp && cd ~/claude-peers-mcp && bun install && claude mcp add --scope user --transport stdio claude-peers -- bun ~/claude-peers-mcp/server.ts

hook: 486 stars, v2026.05.06. name: claude-skills-mcp (K-Dense-AI) — Vector Search for Your Installed Skills
hook: MCP server for searching and retrieving Claude Agent Skills using vector search — a meta-MCP that solves the discovery problem created by the explosion of available skills. When you have 337+ alirezarezvani skills, 1,500+ antigravity skills, or a custom skill collection installed, finding the right skill for a task requires knowing the exact name. This server lets Claude search semantically: 'find me a skill that handles database migrations' returns the closest match from everything installed. Directly addresses the 'I have too many skills to remember' problem.
